messages:
Marnie Hammond: hi everyone! Marnie here, joining growth product today. remote in denver, usually 9-5 MT. obsessed with french press coffee and city maps :coffee::world_map:
Jonas Reed: welcome Marnie!! if youre coming to the office, badge pickup is at people ops after 10am. say youre with Growth Product :idcard:
Priya Singh: hey Marnie, welcome :) we do a quick rooftop snack circle on Fridays at 4. bring a weird snack and a story :tada::cookie:
Marnie Hammond: rooftop snacks sound perfect. weird snack: pickled mango? would that be too weird? :mango:
Eli Navarro: weve got a small pickles stalwart in the pantry, so youd be in good company. also FYI the 3rd-floor french press is on a timer so mornings are prime :alarm_clock::coffee:
Jonas Reed: pro tip: the office map by the elevator has stickers where folks park favorite lunch spots. stick a pin where your fav is and well add it to the map :pushpin::map:
onboarding-bot: Welcome Marnie! A buddy (Jonas Reed) has been assigned and a "New Hire Welcome" event is on your calendar at 11:15. Check your DMs for onboarding docs. :robot_face:
Marnie Hammond: got the invite, thanks bot. quick poll: lunchtime wander — street tacos (corner stand) or bagels from the deli? vote with :taco: or :bagel:
Priya Singh: :taco: for me  were doing spicy salsa
Jonas Reed: :bagel: if we can get an everything with extra capers
Marnie Hammond: tacos win! see you all around
